preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 512.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= R <= 8 and 1 <= C <= 8 and 1 <= K <= 8 for R, C, K in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, R, C, and K are between 1 and 8.

postconditions.description: The number of lines in the output matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, int) and 0 <= line <= 64 for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each line in the output is an integer representing the number of reachable squares, between 0 and 64.
